issues: Both pages were greyscale placeholder dashboards (grey bars, empty cards) with a debug 'BARN DOOR SPLIT' label stamped top left
The two pages had nothing to do with each other, so opening the doors just swapped one grey image for another and never read as new replacing old
The seam was a dark line; the doors opened with no light and no energy, reading like an ordinary left/right wipe
After the doors opened, 70+ frames stood completely still with no follow-through, so the back half was dead
changes: Ember look (warm black, orange): the old page is a cold grey metal slab 'Kiln 3', the new one a 'Kiln 4' launch poster on an ember stage, in the same layout and slots, so when the doors part the '4' stands where the '3' was

The seam is now a light seam: a glowing hairline draws up and down from the centre, then eases open to 16px; the 10px door edges catch the light, the door faces warm near the gap, and the new page develops through one overexposed beam
Rhythm: 20f establish, 10f tease, 10f anticipation, a 24f ease-in slide with velocity-based horizontal motion blur, and the new page rising 1.08→1 to meet the camera
Follow-through: the subline rises word by word and three stats roll from old to new values (64s→11.8s, 12→0, 6→32), so the numbers themselves say 'faster'
Typography: 220px wordmark, 48px subline, 72px stats with 30px labels; during the hold embers drift up and the camera pushes in 1.8%
